How an order works

Four steps from first message to delivery.

  1. ConsultationShare your idea, event date and budget.
  2. Measurements and depositWe take your measurements, or you send them using our guide, and we agree the details. You pay a deposit before we start sewing.
  3. FittingIf you are nearby, you try the piece on and we adjust it.
  4. Collection or deliveryYour outfit is ready in 4 days to 1 week, depending on the clothes. You pay the balance when it is ready. Collect it or ask us to deliver it anywhere in the country.

How to measure

Ordering from far away? Measure yourself, or ask someone to help, and send us the numbers on WhatsApp.

For tops

  • NeckAround the base of the neck. Leave room for one finger.
  • ShoulderAcross the back, from one shoulder bone to the other.
  • ChestAround the fullest part of the chest, under the arms.
  • Sleeve lengthFrom the shoulder bone down to where you want the sleeve to end.
  • Top lengthFrom the base of the neck, over the shoulder, down to where you want the top to end.

For trousers

  • WaistAround the place where you wear your trousers.
  • HipAround the fullest part of the hips.
  • ThighAround the fullest part of the upper leg.
  • Trouser lengthFrom the waist down the outside of the leg to the ankle.
  • Bottom openingHow wide you want the trouser leg at the ankle.
  • Use a soft tape measure and wear thin clothes.
  • Keep the tape flat and snug, but do not pull it tight.
  • Write down if the numbers are in inches or centimetres.
  • Not sure about a number? Send what you have and ask us.

Help

Quick answers. Anything else, send us a message below.

How do I place an order?

Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram, call us, or visit the studio. Tell us the style you want and the date you need it, and we will reply with a quote.

How much does it cost?

Native wear and streetwear start from ₦16,000, Ankara from ₦7,000 and casual wear from ₦6,000. We give you the exact price once you choose a style.

Can I order a style I see on this page?

Yes. Tap "Order on WhatsApp" under any design and we will start the chat for you.

Can I bring my own fabric?

Yes. You can bring your own fabric, or we can supply it. Tell us which you prefer when you message us.

Where is the studio and when is it open?

No. 83 Okwanka Street, Otukpo, Benue State. We are open full time. Open in Google Maps

How can I pay?

You pay a deposit before we start sewing, and the balance when your outfit is ready. You can pay through OPay, Grey, Moniepoint or Access Bank. The OPay, Access Bank, Moniepoint and Grey details are on the Prices page.

How long does an order take?

Most orders take 4 days to 1 week, depending on the clothes.

Do you deliver?

Yes, we deliver anywhere in the country. The fee depends on your location. Message us for the price.
